name: 4DGS-Volume-Cloud Two-Stage Relighting
definition: A two-stage rendering pipeline for physically parameterized volume clouds using 3D Gaussians. Stage 1 trains physical parameters (geometry, extinction, albedo, scattering) under a single sun direction with a black background. Stage 2 freezes these parameters and trains a global environment network to add sky atmospheric scattering, enabling arbitrary sun direction relighting.
summary: 4DGS-Volume-Cloud Two-Stage Relighting is a real-time rendering pipeline that decouples static cloud geometry from dynamic lighting, enabling efficient arbitrary-direction relighting without re-optimizing the cloud structure.
